verdicts.evidence: LCSC C14877 snapshot shows 1000+ at $1.5712 (exact match, 4,610 in stock), https://www.lcsc.com/product-image/C14877.html. Other LCSC snapshots at 1000+: $1.3448, $1.4176, $2.2097 (the last page marks it 'Not recommended for new designs'); Findchips names Newark $2.29 @100 (https://origin-www.findchips.com/search/ATMEGA328PAU). Snapshot spread $1.34-2.21 at the same break; no Digi-Key/Mouser price found. Not AEC-Q (aecq false is right).

LCSC C78624 snapshot: 1000+ at $2.1295 (exact match, 1,243 in stock); a second snapshot $2.2816 at 1000+ (0 stock). https://www.lcsc.com/product-image/C78624.html. RS HK lists the -AU at HK$30.969 for 250-1000 (tray 250), https://hkcn.rs-online.com/web/p/microcontrollers/1773477 (not converted, not recorded). Commercial grade, aecq false right.

LCSC C79997 product page: 3000+ $0.0127 (matches recorded) and 21000+ $0.0104, https://www.lcsc.com/product-image/C79997.html; the LCSC datasheet PDF shows an older $0.0095 @3000. The recorded Mouser $0.009 @3000 came from a Digipart page whose source was 'assumed' and could not be verified - remove it. RS JP title states AEC-Q101 (https://jp.rs-online.com/web/p/schottky-diodes-rectifiers/1038399); 85 V 215 mA SOT-23 matches.

Digi-Key BG (0348302001) re-seen at about EUR 5.06 @1200 (rounded summary only, 978 stock), https://www.digikey.bg/en/products/detail/molex/0348302001/4693138. Independent exact figure: RS UK tray listing GBP 3.92 @300 (GBP 1,176.00 per tray of 300) ~ EUR 4.5, within 25% of EUR 5.06; RS single-pack listing GBP 4.962 @100; https://uk.rs-online.com/p/automotive-connectors/1789698 (search summary did not tie each figure to listing 1789698 vs 1790563). LCSC lists 348302001 (C277647) at $2.6138 @900, about half - wide spread, flag. RS describes it as 20-way, 2-row, through-hole solder header (MX150, 3.5 mm). Connector, AEC-Q n/a.

Both recorded observations were read from Source ESB (api-websites-cached.sourceesb.com), a disallowed source. The only Digi-Key listing (https://www.digikey.com.mx/en/products/detail/wec/G8ND-2S-ASSK/14750515: $2.70 @30, $2.66 @150, $2.60 @300) is a Digi-Key Marketplace third-party seller (WEC), not Digi-Key franchised stock. Three searches found no Mouser/Arrow/TTI/Future/Farnell/RS price; only ormix.lv (zero stock) and eBay. Omron's own code is G8ND-2S DC12; the -ASSK suffix appears only on the marketplace/aggregator listings. Relay: no AEC-Q, aecq false right.

Distributor spread ~14x ($0.0096-0.135) - the catalogue should use a median, not one figure. 1uF 25V X7R 0603 AEC-Q200 (GCM) correct.

LCSC C161232: 4000+ $0.0110-0.0112 (matches), https://www.lcsc.com/product-image/C161232.html. Three searches found no TTI/Rutronik/Mouser/Digi-Key price for this exact code. The recorded source (https://www.findchips.com/search/1h104k) is a generic search, so the TTI/Rutronik rows may belong to another 1H104K code - not attributable. The rounded element14 figure (~$0.019) is consistent with TTI $0.021 but is not a confirmation.
